<user_query>
Create the JARVIS TRADER options engine module. Create these 5 files. The project root is c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\.

First, create the directory:
- Shell: mkdir c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\engine\options

Then create these 5 files using the Write tool:

FILE 1: c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\engine\options\__init__.py
Content: empty (just a comment # JARVIS Trader Options Engine)

FILE 2: c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\engine\options\greeks_monitor.py
Full Black-Scholes Greeks calculator with:
- calculate_greeks(S, K, T, r, sigma, option_type) -> dict with delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho
- implied_volatility(market_price, S, K, T, r, option_type) -> float (Newton-Raphson solver)
- iv_rank(current_iv, iv_52w_high, iv_52w_low) -> float (0-100)
- iv_percentile(iv_history: list, current_iv) -> float
- PortfolioGreeks dataclass with total delta, gamma, theta, vega across all positions
- Monitor class that tracks Greeks in real-time and returns alerts when delta > 0.30 on short strikes

FILE 3: c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\engine\options\premium_calculator.py
Content:
- black_scholes_price(S, K, T, r, sigma, option_type) -> float
- probability_of_profit(S, K, T, r, sigma, option_type, target_pct=0.5) -> float
- expected_value(premium, prob_profit, max_profit, max_loss) -> float
- premium_scan_result(symbol, strategy_type, strikes, expiry, greeks, pnl_scenarios) dataclass
- get_credit_spread_metrics(sell_strike, buy_strike, sell_premium, buy_premium) -> dict
  Returns: net_premium, max_profit, max_risk, breakeven, risk_reward_ratio, pop

FILE 4: c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\engine\options\strategy_executor.py
Content:
- OptionsStrategy enum: COVERED_CALL, CREDIT_SPREAD_PUT, CREDIT_SPREAD_CALL, IRON_CONDOR, PROTECTIVE_PUT, STRADDLE, STRANGLE
- OptionsOrder dataclass: symbol, strategy, legs (list of dicts with action/type/strike/expiry/qty), estimated_premium, max_risk, max_profit, notes
- build_covered_call(symbol, futures_price, atr, expiry_dte) -> OptionsOrder
  - Short strike = futures_price + 1.0*atr, delta target 0.30
- build_bull_put_spread(symbol, futures_price, atr, width, expiry_dte) -> OptionsOrder  
  - Short put at 0.30 delta, long put 2-3 strikes lower
- build_bear_call_spread(symbol, futures_price, atr, width, expiry_dte) -> OptionsOrder
- build_iron_condor(symbol, futures_price, atr, wing_width, expiry_dte) -> OptionsOrder
  - Short strikes at 0.16 delta (1 SD), only in RANGING regime
- build_protective_put(symbol, futures_price, atr, expiry_dte) -> OptionsOrder
  - Long put at 0.20 delta, trigger: VIX > 20 AND regime VOLATILE
- build_straddle(symbol, futures_price, expiry_dte) -> OptionsOrder
  - ATM call + ATM put, for pre-FOMC/CPI events
- validate_order(order, vix_regime, regime_state) -> tuple[bool, str]
  - Returns (is_valid, reason). Iron condors BLOCKED in HIGH/EXTREME VIX.

FILE 5: c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\engine\options\position_manager.py
Content:
- OptionsPosition dataclass: id, symbol, strategy, legs, entry_premium, current_premium, entry_date, expiry, status, greeks
- OptionsPositionManager class:
  - add_position(order, fill_premium) -> OptionsPosition
  - get_positions() -> list[OptionsPosition]  
  - get_expiring_soon(days=7) -> list[OptionsPosition]
  - check_roll_candidates() -> list[OptionsPosition]  # delta > 0.30 on short strikes
  - get_portfolio_greeks() -> PortfolioGreeks
  - close_position(position_id, close_premium) -> dict (pnl summary)
  - positions stored in SQLite at engine/db/options_positions.db

FILE 6: c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\engine\options\chain_fetcher.py
Content:
- OptionsChain dataclass: symbol, expiry, underlying_price, iv_rank, calls (list), puts (list)
- OptionsContract dataclass: strike, expiry, bid, ask, mid, delta, gamma, theta, vega, iv, volume, oi
- fetch_chain_yfinance(symbol, expiry_dates=None) -> OptionsChain
  - Use yfinance Ticker(symbol).option_chain(expiry) to get real data
  - Calculate greeks via greeks_monitor.calculate_greeks
- filter_by_delta(chain, min_delta, max_delta) -> list[OptionsContract]
- find_strike_by_delta(chain, target_delta, option_type) -> OptionsContract | None
- get_iv_rank(symbol, days=252) -> float
  - Pull 1y of IV data from yfinance options history

Write ALL files with complete, production-quality Python code. Use proper imports, type hints, dataclasses, logging.
</user_query>

The user wants me to create 6 files (they said 5 but listed 6) for the JARVIS TRADER options engine module. Let me first read the JARVIS trader skill to understand the project context, then create the directory and all files.

**JARVIS Trader Options Engine** — `engine/options/` — 6 files, ~79 KB of production Python

| File | Size | What's inside |
|------|------|---------------|
| `__init__.py` | 31 B | Package marker |
| `greeks_monitor.py` | 15.6 KB | Full Black-Scholes Greeks (`calculate_greeks`), Newton-Raphson IV solver (`implied_volatility`), `iv_rank`, `iv_percentile`, `PortfolioGreeks` dataclass, `GreeksMonitor` class with delta-breach alerts at configurable threshold (default 0.30 on short strikes) |
| `premium_calculator.py` | 10 KB | `black_scholes_price`, `probability_of_profit` (risk-neutral N(d2)), `expected_value`, `PremiumScanResult` dataclass, `get_credit_spread_metrics` (bull put + bear call), `pnl_at_expiry` scenarios |
| `strategy_executor.py` | 21.5 KB | `OptionsStrategy` / `VIXRegime` / `RegimeState` enums; `OptionsOrder` + `OptionsLeg` dataclasses; all 7 builders (`covered_call`, `bull_put_spread`, `bear_call_spread`, `iron_condor`, `protective_put`, `straddle`, `strangle`); `validate_order` with full regime rules — iron condors blocked in HIGH/EXTREME VIX, RANGING-only enforcement, protective put VOLATILE trigger |
| `position_manager.py` | 17.5 KB | `OptionsPosition` dataclass with `unrealised_pnl` / `realised_pnl` / `dte` properties; `OptionsPositionManager` with SQLite persistence (`engine/db/options_positions.db`, WAL mode); `add_position`, `get_positions`, `get_expiring_soon`, `check_roll_candidates`, `update_greeks`, `close_position`, `get_portfolio_greeks` |
| `chain_fetcher.py` | 14.3 KB | `OptionsContract` + `OptionsChain` dataclasses; `fetch_chain_yfinance` with live Greeks calculation; `filter_by_delta`, `find_strike_by_delta`; `get_iv_rank` using 21-day rolling HV as proxy; `fetch_nearest_expiries` for multi-expiry sweeps |
